subject: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & success charter for Halogen
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@halogen.ai>, Aaron Lockwood <aaron.lockwood@halogen.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & success charter for Halogen

Hi Priya / Aaron —

Thanks again for the time last week. As promised, I put together a short activation plan to align on goals, success criteria, and a working timeline so we have a shared view for the evaluation. Attached is a first-pass draft ("halogen_activation_roadmap_draft_v1.pdf") and a lightweight tech checklist.

Goal of this kickoff email: confirm who is driving each area, lock the 30-day evaluation window, and surface any constraints we should incorporate (security reviews, procurement timeline, exec demo). My proposal below — please confirm or correct.

High-level outcomes we want to validate in the pilot:
- Model behavior: representative prompts + quality threshold (BLEU/ROUGE-style / human review)
- Latency & cost: 95th percentile latency target and estimated token spend envelope
- Integration: basic SDK end-to-end in a staging environment
- Security: evidence checklist and access model (VPC / Private)

Proposed timeline (target dates):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder roster + kickoff workshop (30–45 min)
- Week 1: technical workshop (SE-led) + access provisioning
- Week 2–3: evaluation runs, prompt tuning, perf tests
- Week 4: exec demo + decision window (pilot->POC/contract)

Please confirm:
1) Champion / primary decision-maker for the evaluation (who will sign off at the end of Week 4)
2) Any fixed blackout dates or procurement windows we should avoid
3) Security/compliance evidence required up front (SOC2, IP agreements, data residency)

Next steps from our side once you confirm attendees: I will schedule the kickoff and technical workshop invites, Marissa will prepare the mutual success charter template, and Soojin will scope the demo environment.

Attachments: halogen_activation_roadmap_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 180 KB); tech-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Priya Sharma <priya@halogen.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lockwood <aaron.lockwood@halogen.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, procurement@halogen.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & success charter for Halogen

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and a good starting point. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Champion: I will act as the internal champion and primary point of contact for day-to-day decisions. Aaron (CTO) will be the technical approver and should be looped into the technical workshop. Procurement has been cc'd and will need the standard T&Cs + an outline of the pilot spend before we move to any purchase order.

2) Timeline: the 30-day window works for us, but we have an internal offsite the week of Nov 22–26 that will limit exec availability for a live demo that week. If possible, let's aim to complete the demo the week of Dec 6 instead (still within a 4–6 week evaluation band).

3) Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report + data handling overview + auditors contact would be required for our security team to sign off. If you can surface the SOC 2 report and a short summary page that lists any third-party subprocessors, that will speed review.

4) Attendees for kickoff: Priya (Champion), Aaron (CTO), Sandeep Rao (Infra Lead — sandeep@halogen.ai), Procurement (procurement@halogen.ai). Please include a short agenda for the kickoff call (30–45 min).

Can you propose two windows for the kickoff? We prefer mornings PST — Wed 11/11 or Thu 11/12 between 9–11am PST.

Appreciate it — excited to see the activation plan in action.

—Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Product, Halogen.ai
priya@halogen.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & success charter for Halogen

Priya — thanks for the quick reply and the clarity on dates. Wed 11/11 at 9:30am PST works for our team; I scheduled a 30-minute kickoff and sent an invite to all attendees. Calendar invite includes a short agenda and the shared Drive link for the plan.

Updated, actionable items (owners):
- Confirmed champion: Priya Sharma (Halogen) — owner: Priya
- Technical approver: Aaron Lockwood (Halogen) — owner: Aaron / Soojin for the SE session
- Procurement touchpoint: procurement@halogen.ai — owner: Marissa (will follow up with PO expectations and a pilot spend estimate)
- SOC 2 evidence + subprocessors: Ben to share SOC 2 summary and link to secure evidence (Ben)
- Demo environment & access: Soojin to provision staging keys and a short runbook (Soojin)

I've attached an updated activation roadmap (halogen_activation_roadmap_draft_v1.pdf — same filename, minor edits) and included two links: the HubSpot deal record and the shared Drive folder with the mutual success charter template. Marissa — I'll defer to you to drop in your success charter fields after this kickoff (RACI, acceptance criteria, escalation path).

Links:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321/HLG-2027-0421
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E-halogen-map

Immediate next internal steps (our side):
1) Ben: share SOC 2 summary + auditors contact (by EOD today)
2) Marissa: procurement intro and pilot budget ask (by tomorrow)
3) Soojin: prework checklist and short list of env requirements (before the technical workshop)

If anything changes on your side, please call or DM me — otherwise we'll proceed with the kickoff tomorrow at 9:30am PST.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
